$comment: Projects suggested on Home in a new library and under Add project (docs/DESKTOP_PLAN.md, 'Starter projects as GitHub projects'). Adding one is the ordinary Add from GitHub, so each gets update checks and is checked at its defaults. Projects whose license isn't settled for sharing (openGrid, Underware) wait. 'name' is the name the project gets once added; 'models' says what adding it brings (counted at the commits CI tests, Review 3's UI-23); 'license' is its SPDX id.
